classical check 2026-09-21 (O11 / M10): carry_yin.wide is an interpretive analogy, the classics make 辛 welcoming Fire conditional. 滴天髓 辛金 熱則喜母，寒則喜丁 (原注: 生於九夏而得己土則能晦火而存之；生於隆冬而得丁火則能敵寒而養之…辛金生於冬月，見丙火則男命不貴…見丁男女皆貴且順; 任注: 生於夏而火多，有己土則晦火而生金；生於冬而水旺，有丁火則溫水而養金). 窮通寶鑑 論辛金: Fire only in the cold months and paired with 壬水 (正月 辛金珠玉，最怕紅爐; 四月 忌丙火之燥烈，喜壬水之洗淘; 五月 不宜煆煉; 八月 專用壬水淘洗; 十月 先用壬水，次取丙火…名金白水清; 十一月 冬月辛金，須丙溫暖，方妙; 十二月 先丙後壬…無壬不能洗淘). Station line unchanged.

mechanism.base: Fire tames metal, the old texts say, and the forge softens the blade. Cold steel is hard and brittle, and only heat lets it take a shape it can keep. The smith holds the edge in the coals until it glows, works it while it is soft and cools it again. The fire gives the metal nothing it did not already have. It only decides what the steel is made into.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Fire, the steel never reaches the forge and stays hard, cold and unshaped. Strength that answers to no one never gets its shape. Take on one deadline you did not set.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Fire, the forge runs hotter than the blade can take, and the edge softens under every demand until nothing holds a line. Sleep on the next demand before you answer it.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Fire fuels it, and outside demands shape you. As a catalyst, nothing tests you, and over time you want a crisis as much as a rank. You get most done under rules someone else set.
function.definition_friction: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Fire lights it, so standards reach you. As a friction, pressure piles up until you obey a crisis ahead of rest and a rule over your judgment. You end up tired and doubting yourself.
function.advise_catalyst: You do your best work when someone is allowed to tell you no. Pick one job this month that comes with a deadline and a judge, and ship it on time. Make the hard call out loud in front of the people it affects. Finish one small thing before anyone has to chase you for it.
function.advise_friction: Seek Earth, the Mind energy. Earth takes the blaze in and keeps the warmth, ground that does not catch. Let it hold what Fire burns. You answer to pressure faster than you recover from it. Spend one evening a week with nobody to report to. Read the whole message before the next hard call.

candidates.cta_verdict: You work harder for a standard someone else set than for one of your own, and you usually go looking for one.

catalyst.clause: The steel never reaches the forge and stays hard, cold and unshaped.
catalyst.remedy: Take on one deadline you did not set.

friction.clause: The forge runs hotter than the blade can take.
friction.remedy: Sleep on the next demand before you answer it.

wide.clause: Fire is one thing you never run short of, the forge the steel is shaped in.
wide.remedy: Use it. Take the job that has a judge.

missing.clause: No forge anywhere near the steel, so nothing ever tests the edge or gives it a shape.
missing.remedy: Borrow heat. A coach, a deadline, someone allowed to say no.

spared.clause: No fire near the steel, and better so, since nothing presses a thin edge out of shape.
spared.remedy: Leave it cold. Set your own standards for now.

thin.clause: A small fire by the steel, enough to warm it and not enough to soften the edge.
thin.remedy: Keep it small. One standard at a time.

excess.clause: Too much fire for this much metal, so the edge melts before it takes a shape.
excess.remedy: Step back from the heat. Fewer judges, more sleep.

catalyst.clause: Nothing tests you: a stone that keeps its first cut and calls it character.

friction.clause: The wheel never stops: constant pressure, no bench time, a stone thinned by a polish it never leaves.
friction.remedy: Step off the wheel long enough to keep a facet.

wide.clause: Fire is easy for you to reach, the fire that finishes the stone.
wide.remedy: Take the pressure you have. Let it sharpen you.

mechanism_yin.base: The refined prevails over the stubborn: fire alone commands metal. In the kiln the unbending learns to bend, ore gives up its rock, and the stone takes whatever colour the flame decides. Heat is the one argument metal cannot win, and what survives the fire comes out finer than what went in.
mechanism_yin.catalyst_turn: Run thin, nothing tests you: a stone that keeps its first cut and calls it character. Your chart asks for heat. Take the demanding role, the audit, the arena.
mechanism_yin.friction_turn: Run heavy, the wheel never stops: constant pressure, no bench time, a stone thinned by a polish it never leaves. Step off the wheel long enough to keep a facet.

__ore.retired_fn_body: The Duty is your accountability function: how order, obligation, and other people’s expectations sit on you. With Fire running it, accountability in you is hot and visible: exacting seniors, stakes with deadlines, standards enforced in public. You hold rank by surviving heat gracefully, and people trust steel that has been through the forge. Choose fires that finish you, not ones that just burn.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Metal, and Fire tames Metal: the forge softens the blade. Fire is the heat that presses on you, deadlines, authority, scrutiny, crisis, and pressure is exactly what a blade is finished by. That is why Fire is your Order, the discipline that shapes you. The forge is not your enemy. It is the only thing that reworks your edge.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Fire is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is the pressure that organizes you: deadlines, scrutiny, real stakes. You focus best when something is genuinely on the line, and drift when nothing is.

Clutch, competitive, deadline-bright. More gets finished in the last two days than the quiet two weeks before, a witness makes you work better, and the moment a deadline moves, the whole structure sags. The low-stakes seasons are the expensive ones.

You are built to be held by stakes, so choose them before they choose you. Keep one commitment with external accountability at all times, a client, a coach, a date that cannot move. Cut long projects into short public checkpoints. When drive dips, add stakes before effort.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Fire is your Order, and as a friction, it is pressure landing on reserves that are already low: every demand feels urgent, so you answer all of them and recover from none.

Responsible to a fault, respected, quietly clenched. The calendar fills with other people’s emergencies, the jaw stays tight through dinner, and the standards keep getting met at costs nobody around you sees. Saying no still feels more dangerous than being drained does.

Every demand you absorb is a choice wearing a disguise. Choose openly instead: name the two obligations that pay you back and practice a slow no on the rest. Build one pressure-free hour into every day. Before accepting anything new, say what it replaces.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.action: Under real pressure you act cleaner: crisis burns off your hesitation.
